verdict.rationale: Google Workspace provides directory APIs to suspend/delete users and automatic provisioning sync so changes propagate to at least one connected third-party app (e.g., Office 365), plus device wipe capability, suggesting some deprovisioning cascade exists. However, there's no explicit evidence of a single action that both kills active sessions and deprovisions across all SCIM-connected apps immediately — the sync appears limited to specific integrations rather than a universal SCIM-driven instant offboarding flow. missing for 10: explicit session-kill-on-deactivation documentation, evidence of SCIM deprovisioning across broad third-party app ecosystem, and confirmation of immediacy/real-time propagation.
